verdict.rationale: The only first-party evidence is marketing copy saying users can configure the platform so each payment automatically appears categorized by area, owner and expense type. That is a narrow, user-configured action triggered by a payment event. Nothing in the evidence describes a general rules engine, event triggers, webhooks, or other configurable actions; the API docs cover only on-demand CRUD operations. Missing for 10: documented rule-definition capability, a range of trigger events and actions beyond categorization, webhooks or event subscriptions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Personalize a plataforma para que cada pagamento já apareça devidamente categorizado por área, responsável e tipo de despesa.
